justification: Panel A shows a worn, roughly hewn stone with faint traces of vertical elements and possibly figural or geometric carving in a coarse, weathered style, while panel B shows a smooth incised plaque with a clear horizontal inscription band and an elaborate interlace cross with foliate scrollwork. The only loose commonality is the general presence of a cross-like element and some kind of carved marking, but the specific forms, arrangement (inscription plus rosette-like cross vs. indistinct figural carving), and stylistic conventions (fine linear interlace vs. rough relief) are entirely different.
